asf.sample.record = {
	active count = 1
	path = /Users/operator/Library/LaunchAgents/asf.sample.record.plist
	state = running

	program = /usr/local/bin/python3.12

	arguments = {
		/usr/local/bin/python3.12
		-m
		asf.cli
		tick
		--product
		sample
		--steps
		record
	}

	default environment = {
		PATH => /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
	}

	environment = {
		PATH => /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
		HOME => /Users/operator
		PYTHONPATH => /Users/operator/src/asf
	}

	domain = gui/501 [100005]
	asid = 100005
	minimum runtime = 10
	exit timeout = 5
	runs = 7
	last exit code = 0

	stdout path = /Users/operator/.ASF/logs/tick-sample-record.log
	stderr path = /Users/operator/.ASF/logs/tick-sample-record.log

	spawn type = daemon (3)
	jetsam priority = 40
	jetsam memory limit (active) = (unlimited)
	jetsam memory limit (inactive) = (unlimited)
	jetsamproperties category = daemon
	properties = keepalive | runatload | inferred program
}
